privileged_info_for_vlm: The survey title must be 'IT Asset Audit 2025'. The group name must be 'Hardware Details'. Question codes must be exactly: AssetTag, MacAddr, PurchYear, WarrYear. AssetTag regex must match 'IT-12345' (e.g., /^IT-[0-9]{5}$/). MacAddr regex must match standard MAC format (e.g., /^([0-9A-Fa-f]{2}:){5}[0-9A-Fa-f]{2}$/). The WarrYear validation equation must ensure WarrYear >= PurchYear.
